title: Expose immutable outcome censor reason distribution
objective: Implement the smallest deterministic read-only summary of existing MATURED_OUTCOME_v3 censor reasons so architecture/learning review can distinguish deliberate quarantine from evidence-availability and provenance/resolver censoring. Preserve every immutable outcome and all current censor semantics.
primary_target: scripts/learning/directly related outcome quality summary helper
allowed_change_scope: scripts/learning/directly related read-only outcome censor quality summary helper
scripts/architecture_health/directly related evidence-health aggregation if an existing owner consumes the summary
tests/learning/directly related outcome censor quality tests
research/architecture_health/directly related generated censor-quality pointer or summary artifact

evidence.summary: Current health exposes aggregate censored_outcome_count and censor_rate but no reason distribution.
Maturation emits multiple materially different censor reasons while preserving immutable outcomes.
Resolver defines distinct fail-closed censor statuses for unavailable namespaces, unavailable metrics and root-contract ambiguity/absence.

reproduction: On fresh main, read architecture health and confirm only aggregate censor count/rate is exposed. Read immutable outcome rows and maturation/resolver code and confirm multiple exact censor reasons exist but are not summarized by reason/class on the health surface.

positive: Generated reason counts reconcile exactly to immutable MATURED_OUTCOME_v3 files and preserve exact raw reason strings.
Known reason categories separate deliberate legacy quarantine from availability/contract and provenance/resolver classes without changing outcome status.
negative: Unknown censor reasons remain UNCLASSIFIED_FAIL_CLOSED and are never silently bucketed into a known causal class.
The implementation never edits outcome files, uncensors rows, changes maturity windows or uses mutable LATEST evidence as a scored outcome.
